chunks: Al-ʿAbbās ibn Bakkār al-Ḍabbī narrated, saying: Muḥammad ibn Sulaymān al-Kūfī al-Bazzāz narrated to us, saying: ʿAmr ibn Khālid narrated from Zayd ibn ʿAlī, from his father ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn, from his father al-Ḥusayn ibn ʿAlī, from his father Amīr al-Muʾminīn ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib عليه السلام, who said:

Whoever dies on Thursday after the sun passes its zenith until Friday at the time of zenith, and is a believer, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, will protect him from the squeezing of the grave and accept his intercession for as many as Rabīʿah and Muḍar. Whoever dies on Saturday from among the believers, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, will never gather him with the Jews in the Fire. Whoever dies on Sunday from among the believers, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, will never gather him with the Christians in the Fire. Whoever dies on Monday from among the believers, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, will never gather him with our enemies from Banū Umayyah in the Fire. Whoever dies on Tuesday from among the believers, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, will resurrect him with us in the Highest Company. Whoever dies on Wednesday from among the believers, Allah will protect him from the ill fate of the Day of Resurrection, make him felicitous by nearness to Him, and settle him in the Abode of Permanence by His grace; no fatigue will touch him therein, nor will weariness touch him therein.

Then he عليه السلام said: The believer, in whatever state he dies and on whatever day and hour he is taken, is a truthful one and a martyr. And I indeed heard my beloved, the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, saying: If the believer were to leave the world bearing sins like the sins of the people of the earth, death would be an expiation for those sins.
Then he عليه السلام said: Whoever says, “There is no god but Allah,” with sincerity is free from shirk, and whoever leaves this world not associating anything with Allah shall enter Paradise.

Then he recited this verse: “Indeed, Allah does not forgive that partners be associated with Him, and He forgives what is less than that for whomsoever He wills” — from among your Shiʿah and your lovers, O ʿAlī.

Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام said: So I said, “O Messenger of Allah, is this for my Shiʿah?” He said: “Yes, by my Lord, it is for your Shiʿah. They shall indeed come forth on the Day of Resurrection from their graves saying: ‘There is no god but Allah, Muḥammad is the Messenger of Allah, ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib is the proof of Allah.’ Then they will be given green garments from Paradise, wreaths from Paradise, crowns from Paradise, and noble mounts from Paradise. Each one of them will wear a green garment, and upon his head will be placed the crown of sovereignty and the wreath of honor. Then they will ride the noble mounts, and they will fly with them to Paradise: ‘The Greatest Terror shall not grieve them, and the angels shall receive them: This is your Day which you were promised.’”

key_terms.الرَّفِيقِ الْأَعْلَى: the Highest Company, a lofty station of nearness
key_terms.الْفَزَعُ الْأَكْبَرُ: the greatest terror of the Day of Resurrection
key_terms.حُجَّةُ اللَّهِ: the proof of Allah, a divinely authoritative representative
key_terms.شَفَاعَتَهُ: his intercession accepted by Allah for others
key_terms.ضَغْطَةِ الْقَبْرِ: the squeezing or constriction of the grave in barzakh

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about the death of a believer, freedom from shirk, and the salvation of the Shiʿah of Imam Ali عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith describes special divine mercy for believers who die on different days of the week, then broadens the meaning by affirming that the believer is honored in death regardless of the exact time of passing. It emphasizes tawhid, freedom from shirk, the forgiveness of sins, the salvation of the Shiʿah of Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام, and their blessed resurrection and entry into Paradise.
